# Fodor's Travel

> > Fodor's Travel provides expert travel guides and vacation planning resources for destinations across Africa, the Middle East, and worldwide.

Fodor's Travel is a comprehensive travel guide platform offering destination guides, hotel recommendations, restaurant reviews, and activity suggestions for travelers. The site covers major regions including Africa, the Middle East, Asia, Europe, the Caribbean, and the Americas, with detailed guides for countries like Israel, South Africa, Jordan, Kenya, and Namibia.

## Key Topics

- Destination guides
- Vacation planning
- Africa travel
- Middle East travel
- Safari destinations
- Israel destinations
- South Africa travel
- Jordan travel
- Hotel recommendations
- Restaurant reviews
- Side trips and excursions
- National parks
- Desert destinations
- Coastal destinations
- Cultural tourism

## Regional Overview

- [Africa and Middle East Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east): Comprehensive regional travel guide overview for Africa and Middle East destinations

## Major Country Guides

- [Israel Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east/israel): Complete Israel destination guide with hotels, restaurants, and sightseeing recommendations
- [Kenya Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east/kenya): Kenya destination guide featuring safari activities, hotels, and restaurants
- [Namibia Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east/namibia): Comprehensive Namibia travel guide with accommodations and activities
- [Botswana Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east/botswana): Botswana destination guide featuring safari experiences and lodging options
- [Rwanda Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east/rwanda): Rwanda travel guide with hotels, restaurants, and tourism activities

## Top Destinations and Cities

- [Petra Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east/jordan/petra): Expert guide to Petra, Jordan featuring hotels, sightseeing, and activities
- [Tel Aviv Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east/israel/tel-aviv): Tel Aviv destination guide with hotels, dining, and entertainment options
- [Mpumalanga and Kruger National Park Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east/south-africa/mpumalanga-and-kruger-national-park): Premier safari destination guide for Mpumalanga and Kruger National Park
- [Johannesburg Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east/south-africa/johannesburg): Johannesburg city guide featuring hotels, activities, and attractions

## Specialty Destinations

- [Near Amboseli and Tsavo West Travel Guide](https://www.fodors.com/world/africa-and-middle-east/kenya/near-amboseli-and-tsavo-west): Kenya safari destinations featuring Amboseli and Tsavo West national parks
